summary: Heinrich Gross, also written Henri Gross, was a German rabbi born on November 6, 1835 in Szenicz, in the Hungarian Kingdom (now Senica, Slovakia). He died in 1910. He studied rabbinical literature under Judah Aszod.
one_line: Heinrich Gross (Henri Gross), German rabbi born in Szenicz in 1835 and died in 1910, was a pupil of Judah Aszod.
